description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340015500227 CAP-PLUG,PROTECTIVE: Line 0001 Qty 10 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0061 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
